new_features.name: Service messages
new_features.description: Receive remotely configured service messages (the message system) targeted by date range, app version, platform, device, firmware, settings and country.
new_features.platform_notes: All platforms fetch the signed message-system configuration and show only messages whose conditions match. The same configuration also drives feature availability gates and experiments used by other features.

navigation.web: Automatically shown when an applicable remote service message is active

Evaluates message conditions: date range, environment and app version, OS, browser, transport, settings, device/firmware and country.

new_features.name: Legacy Bridge deprecation notice
new_features.description: Detect a running legacy standalone Trezor Bridge and explain how to uninstall it.
new_features.platform_notes: Desktop probes the legacy trezord-go endpoint (127.0.0.1:21325) each time SuiteBanners mounts. Web probes only while the Local Network Access permission is granted, so it never triggers the permission prompt, and the probe re-runs when the permission becomes granted. Only a 2.x version response counts as legacy. Mobile has no standalone Bridge transport.

navigation.desktop: Suite banner 'Trezor Bridge has been deprecated' (app, onboarding or welcome layout) > Learn more
navigation.web: Suite banner 'Trezor Bridge has been deprecated' (app, onboarding or welcome layout) > Learn more

evidence.detail: Warning modal 'Trezor Bridge has been deprecated' with a link to the uninstall guide (UNINSTALL_BRIDGE_URL) and a Take me back to wallet button; backdrop or cancel also returns to the wallet.
useLegacyBridgeDetection POSTs to http://127.0.0.1:21325/ with a 5 s timeout and flags only a 2.x version string. On web it probes only while Local Network Access is granted.
Info banner with a Learn more button that opens the suite-bridge-deprecated foreground app.
Shown at banner priority 30 when legacy Bridge is detected and no higher-priority banner applies (for example Local Network Access at 40).
Foreground app 'bridge-deprecated' (route /bridge-deprecated, routeConfig.ts:164-170) renders the BridgeDeprecated modal.

Co-located unit tests for the detection hook (2.x detected; non-ok, missing, non-string, 3.x or unrelated versions and network errors ignored; fetch aborted on unmount); not executed, hook-level only, not the user journey.

ownership.basis: Transport and Bridge guidance; matches the Connect ownership of sibling features connection.bridge and connection.local-network. Not a CODEOWNERS assignment.

conditions: desktop-web: A legacy standalone trezord-go (2.x) answers on 127.0.0.1:21325 when SuiteBanners mounts; on web only while Local Network Access permission is granted. There is no retry interval, so a legacy Bridge started later is detected only on a later mount or reload.
mobile: No standalone Bridge transport exists on mobile.

screenshot.notes: Needs a legacy trezord-go 2.x running on port 21325; not captured.
